398.docs: A control with no name: a screen reader says only what it is.

473.docs: The screen, as the navigation calls it, or the theme.

598.name: check_focus
598.docs:
Presses Tab across the screen and says whether the focus moves and reaches every control.
The focus is left where the last press put it.

What the application changes by itself on the way, such as a reminder that comes due, is not
held against the screen: a control counts as never reached only when it is there from the
first press to the last, and a window that opens on the way ends the walk.

673.name: description
673.docs:
What is said after the name. With none, the control keeps what it has, such as the hint
of a field.

748.name: for_language
748.docs: In the language of this code, as `en` or `pt-BR`; English for any other.

244.name: LiveRegion
244.docs: What an [`Announcer`] says, as a node of the accessibility tree and nothing on the screen.

671.name: click
671.docs: Clicks the enabled node with this role and name, if the screen has one.

242.name: recent
242.docs: The last few things said, newest last.

619.name: screen
619.docs: Looks at the screen as it is.

392.name: MOST_TABS

417.name: SharedShortcut

744.name: deleted_many
744.docs: More than one was: `{0}` is how many.

617.name: skip
617.docs: Leaves out the item of the navigation with this name, as one that leaves the application.

390.name: TEXT_CONTRAST
390.docs: The least contrast for text, as WCAG asks of normal text (AA).

415.name: keys
415.docs: The keys, as they are written next to a command.

742.name: not_saved

615.docs: Also checks the contrast of this theme, which the application offers.

740.name: KEYS
740.docs: A text of [`AccessWords`] by its key, for whoever keeps the words of an application.

236.name: polite
236.docs: Says `text` when the screen reader pauses.

613.name: Audit

738.name: names
738.docs:
What screen readers call the fields and the actions of an application, from the model.

The caption is the name, unless the model says otherwise. A field says it with
[`FieldInfo::accessible_name`] and [`FieldInfo::accessible_description`], which the model
copies to the item of its form as `AccessibleName` and `AccessibleDescription`. There a
translation or an administrator changes them, as they do the caption. An action says it with
[`Action::accessible_name`] and [`Action::accessible_description`].

234.name: Announcer

409.name: pair
409.docs: The color in front and the one behind, by their tokens.

811.name: words
811.docs:
What screen readers hear from the framework itself, in each language.

Every text has a key under `a11y.`, as `a11y.saved`. The words come in English and in
Brazilian Portuguese; [`AccessWords::from_lookup`] takes them from anywhere else that answers
by key, which is where the words of the whole application framework plug in.

407.name: FocusTrapped
407.docs: Tab goes round some of the controls and never reaches the others.

3.name: Assertive
3.docs: At once: something that went wrong, or that cannot wait.

607.name: navigation_items
607.docs: The items of the navigation landmarks of a tree: what opens a screen.

1.name: announce
1.docs:
Telling screen readers what changed, without moving the keyboard.

An [`Announcer`] keeps the latest announcement; its [`LiveRegion`] shows it to assistive
technology as a status, which waits for a pause, or as an alert, which interrupts. Nothing of
it shows on the screen. Each announcement is a new node, so the same words said twice are
heard twice, and the last few stay, so one said right after another does not take its place.

605.name: check_theme
605.docs: The pairs of colors of `theme` that are too close to read.

403.name: FocusStuck
403.docs: Tab does not move the focus.

755.name: showing
755.docs: That the screen with this title opened.

603.name: PAIRS
603.docs:
The pairs of tokens a theme has to keep apart: text on what it sits on, and the focus ring on
the window.

401.name: FocusOnNothing
401.docs: Keyboard focus is on a node the tree does not have.

753.name: not_saved
753.docs: That a record was not kept, and why.

174.name: serial
174.docs: Which one it is, counting from the first.

601.name: over
601.docs: A color with some transparency as it shows over `ground`.

676.name: of_field
676.docs:
For a field whose form item is `item` and which the screen calls `caption`. The model's
item comes first, then the declaration, then the caption.

751.name: get
751.docs: The text of this key, for the ones in [`KEYS`].

599.name: close_windows
599.docs: Closes with Escape what stays over the screen, and says so when Escape does not.

674.name: renamed
674.docs: The name is not the caption on the screen.

749.name: from_lookup
749.docs:
Takes each text from `lookup` by its key in [`KEYS`], keeping these words for a key it
does not know. This is how the words of an application, kept anywhere, reach here.

597.name: windows
597.docs: The windows over the screen, by id.

622.name: app
622.docs:
Walks the whole application: the screen it opens on, every item of its navigation, and on
each, the buttons given to [`open`](Self::open).

243.name: region
243.docs: Where screen readers hear it. It takes no room.

393.name: audit
393.docs:
An audit that walks an application the way a keyboard and a screen reader would, and says
what keeps someone out.

[`Audit::app`] opens every item of the navigation, and on each screen the buttons it was told
to press, such as the one that starts a new record. On each one it looks for:

* a control screen readers cannot name, and an id that appears twice;
* keyboard focus on a node that is not there;
* focus held: Tab stays where it is, or goes round some of the controls and never reaches the
  others;
* two commands on the same keys.

It also checks the contrast of text and of the focus ring on every theme it is given, and on
the one on screen. It runs with no window, so a test of any example can call it.

745.name: showing
745.docs: A screen opened: `{0}` is its title.

618.name: without_focus
618.docs: Does not press Tab, for a screen that changes as the focus moves.

391.name: UI_CONTRAST
391.docs: The least contrast for what is not text but has to be seen, such as the focus ring (AA).

239.name: set_quiet
239.docs: Stops saying anything, or starts again, for an application that announces in its own way.

591.name: check_tree
591.docs: What is wrong with the names and ids of a tree.

616.name: open
616.docs:
On every screen, also presses the button with this name when there is one, as `New`, and
looks at what it opens.

414.name: WindowHeld
414.docs: A window over the screen that Escape does not close, so the keyboard cannot leave it.

741.name: saved
741.docs: A record was kept: `{0}` is what names it.

614.name: new
614.docs: Looks at names, ids, focus, shortcuts and the theme on screen.

412.name: LowContrast
412.docs: Two colors of a theme are too close to read one on the other.

739.name: AccessWords
739.docs: The words of the announcements. `{0}` is what each one is about.

33.name: into

Fails, saying everything found, unless nothing was.

When anything was found.
